question: What is the place for ammunition and weapons called?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Arsenal**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Arsenal"** refers to a place where weapons and ammunition are stored or manufactured. (हथियारों और गोला-बारूद का भंडार या निर्माण स्थान)

 
 
• **Example:** The government has decided to increase the security around the arsenal to prevent any unauthorized access.
 
 
 
• An arsenal is critical for ensuring the availability of arms and ammunition during emergencies and military operations. (यह सैन्य संचालन और आपात स्थितियों में हथियारों और गोला-बारूद की उपलब्धता सुनिश्चित करता है।)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Arsenal**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Gallery** (दीर्घा): A room or building for the exhibition of art or historical objects.

 
 
• **Example:** The art gallery displayed works by famous painters from around the world.
 
 
 
• **Library** (पुस्तकालय): A place where books, magazines, and other materials are stored and made available for reading or borrowing.
 
 
• **Example:** She spends her weekends at the library reading novels and researching topics of interest.
 
 
 
• **Laboratory** (प्रयोगशाला): A place equipped for scientific experiments, research, or testing.
 
 
• **Example:** The laboratory was filled with advanced equipment for chemical analysis.
 
 

92:Tc9d,
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
